_note: Tier 0 fixture — Resident, baseline variant, en. § 6.5.3. Values are DISTINCT wherever the source permits distinctness, so a transposition of two keys is caught by value as well as by the ordered paths[] list. Synthetic throughout: no real citizen data, no real UIN, no token (F0-AC-70 item 2). The state is nested under `form` because that is the page's own state object (`ResidentCertificatePage.tsx` reads `form.province`, `form.citizenName`, …): the fixture mirrors the source's state tree so the transcription is auditable key by key against it.
